name: Zivooo
author: Muntasir Rashid

sections.description:
Zivooo is the all in one SEO, GEO and AEO platform: keyword and prompt research, article writing, page audits, rank and AI answer tracking, and publishing, for Google and for AI answers, in one place. There is no subscription and no limit on sites, articles, audits or research. You start free and pay only for what you use.

This plugin is the publishing end of it. Paste one key, and the articles you finish in Zivooo arrive here as real posts: formatted, illustrated, filed under the right category, and carrying the structured data that search engines and AI answer engines read. Publish them one at a time, or let your schedule in Zivooo publish them for you.

Key features

  1. Hands off publishing. Publish an article in Zivooo, or let your schedule do it, and it lands here as a post. There is no export, no copy and paste, and no formatting cleanup afterwards.
  2. Schema in the page head. Every article carries its JSON-LD structured data, printed in the <head> where search engines and AI answer engines actually look for it, not stitched into the body where it usually gets stripped.
  3. Images in your Media Library. Article images are copied onto your own site and set as the featured image, so nothing hot-links an outside host and nothing breaks when storage moves.
  4. Category routing. Zivooo reads your existing categories and files each article under the one you picked, and can create a new category when you ask it to.
  5. Author control. Choose which user articles are published as. Anyone on your site who can publish posts can be the byline.
  6. Works with your SEO plugin. Yoast SEO and Rank Math are detected automatically, and the page level schema they already output is skipped, so you never end up with duplicate Article or Breadcrumb markup.
  7. Safe refreshes. When Zivooo updates a published article, the permalink, the publish state and any category you changed in WordPress all stay exactly as you left them.
  8. Signed requests only. Every request is verified with an HMAC SHA256 signature derived from your key. Anything unsigned or mis-signed is rejected before it reaches your database.
  9. Organization schema on every page. Your company’s name, description and profiles (LinkedIn, Crunchbase and so on) from Zivooo, with your site’s own logo, go into Organization JSON-LD, so search engines and AI assistants connect your site to who you are. With Yoast SEO or Rank Math active, they are added to that plugin’s own Organization instead of printing a second one.
  10. Meta description, set for you. Every article’s meta description, the one Zivooo writes and scores, is printed in the page head. With Yoast SEO, Rank Math or SEOPress active, it fills that plugin’s description field instead, and never replaces one you wrote yourself.
  11. AI traffic counts, if you want them. Turn it on and the plugin counts, per page and per day, visits from AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and others) and visitors arriving from AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Claude). Your Zivooo Performance page shows which pages AI tools read and which ones send you visitors. Off until you turn it on.

What Zivooo costs

The plugin is free. Zivooo itself has no subscription and no plans: every action is priced in credits, and every price is shown before you click.

  • Free to start. New accounts get 1,000 credits with no card, enough to set up your site and its content plan.
  • Pay for what you use. A finished article, researched from the pages that already rank and the AI answers for its keyword, then scored on 40+ factors, is about 149 credits ($1.49).
  • Credits never expire. Packs start at $15. Take a month off and you pay nothing.

External services

This plugin connects your site to Zivooo, an external third party service at https://zivooo.com. The plugin is only useful with an active Zivooo account.

The plugin never initiates a connection to Zivooo on its own. It has no cron jobs, no background checks and no telemetry. Everything below happens only in response to a request that Zivooo signs with the key you paste on the settings screen:

  • Zivooo sends article content to your site: title, body HTML, excerpt, slug, category, JSON-LD schema and image URLs. The plugin creates or updates a post from it.
  • The plugin replies with the resulting post ID, title, permalink, status and modified date, so Zivooo knows what it published here. The same applies to the read endpoints Zivooo uses to reconcile: one returns the posts this plugin created, one returns your post categories.
  • While handling a publish, the plugin downloads that article’s images from Zivooo storage into your Media Library. This is the only outbound HTTP request the plugin makes.
  • Zivooo sends your company’s name, description and profile URLs, which the plugin stores and prints as Organization schema, with the logo set in your theme (or your site icon).
  • Only if you turn on “AI traffic” on the settings screen: Zivooo can read the daily visit totals described under Privacy. With it off, that request returns nothing.

No user accounts or personal data are sent anywhere.

Zivooo’s terms of service are at https://zivooo.com/tos and its privacy policy is at https://zivooo.com/privacy.

Privacy

The plugin does not collect, store or transmit personal data to any third party. It stores one secret key in your site options, used solely to verify that incoming requests really came from Zivooo.

The optional AI traffic counts are off by default. When you turn them on, the plugin keeps, for 90 days, one number per page per day per AI crawler or AI assistant: the date, the page path, which crawler or assistant, and a count. Crawlers are recognized by their published user agent names. Only real pages are counted: not 404s, feeds or redirects, and visits from AI assistants only on posts, pages and the home page. A visitor from an AI assistant is recognized in their browser by the referring site or the link’s utm_source, and the page then posts the assistant’s name and the page path to this site’s own REST API. So that reloading the page does not count the visit twice, the browser tab’s own sessionStorage notes that the page was counted; it is not a cookie, is never sent anywhere and is gone when the tab closes. No IP address, cookie, user agent string, or anything else that identifies a visitor is stored or sent. Turning the setting off stops counting, and deleting the plugin deletes the counts.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the WordPress plugin directory, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it from the Plugins screen.
  3. In Zivooo, open Settings, then Publishing, and click Connect on WordPress. Generate a connection key. Zivooo shows it once.
  4. In WordPress, open the Zivooo menu in the sidebar, paste the key, choose which user articles are published as, and click Save Now.
  5. Back in Zivooo, click Test connection. The Zivooo screen in WordPress shows Connected, and your articles publish here from then on.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Zivooo account?

Yes. This plugin is a connector for the Zivooo service and does nothing on its own. Signing up is free and comes with 1,000 credits, no card needed.

Is there a subscription?

No. Zivooo has no subscription and no plans. You buy credits when you need them, they never expire, and every action shows its price before you run it.

Does it publish articles live, or as drafts?

Whichever you choose in Zivooo. An article can arrive published or as a draft waiting for you.

Where does the schema appear?

In the <head> of each connected post, as valid JSON-LD. That is where search engines and AI answer engines look for it.

What if I already use an SEO plugin?

Yoast SEO and Rank Math are detected automatically. The connector skips the page level schema types they already output, so you will not get duplicate Article or BreadcrumbList markup, and still adds the types they do not cover.

Which category do articles get published to?

Whichever one is chosen in Zivooo for that article, falling back to the default in your Zivooo publishing settings. If neither is set, WordPress applies its own default. Refreshes of an already published article never change its category, so any change you make in WordPress sticks.

Will a refresh overwrite the changes I made in WordPress?

Not the ones that matter. Refreshes leave the permalink, the publish state, the category and any featured image you chose yourself exactly as they are.

What does the AI traffic setting count?

Visits from AI crawlers that read your pages (OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Meta, Mistral, DuckDuckGo, Amazon, ByteDance and Common Crawl) and visitors who arrive from an AI assistant. Google’s and Microsoft’s assistants read pages as Googlebot and Bingbot, which cannot be told apart from search, so they appear only as referrals. If a full-page cache serves your pages, crawler counts miss the cached hits and are a minimum; referral counts are not affected.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Your posts stay where they are. Deleting the plugin removes the stored key, the connection log, the settings and any AI traffic counts, but leaves every published article and its images untouched on your site.
sections.changelog:
1.3.2

  • A meta description saved by 1.3.0’s SEO fixes on a page Zivooo did not publish is no longer printed, and uninstalling deletes it. Descriptions of Zivooo articles are unchanged.

1.3.1

  • Removes the SEO field fixes added in 1.3.0, which Zivooo no longer offers. Fixes already applied are no longer printed, and uninstalling now deletes their stored values.

1.3.0

  • SEO fixes from Zivooo on any published page: SEO title, meta description, image alt text and page schema. Only the named field changes, never the content, title or permalink, and a value edited in WordPress since Zivooo read it is never overwritten. Each fix can be undone.
  • Titles and descriptions are written into Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress or The SEO Framework when one is active. Image alt text and schema are applied as the page renders, so the stored post is unchanged.

1.2.0

  • Each article’s meta description is now printed in the page head. With Yoast SEO, Rank Math or SEOPress active, it fills that plugin’s description field instead, and a description you wrote there yourself is never replaced.

1.1.0

  • Organization schema on every page, from the brand details in Zivooo and your site’s logo. Merged into Yoast SEO’s or Rank Math’s own Organization when one is active.
  • Articles from Zivooo name your site’s logo as the publisher logo.
  • Optional AI traffic counts: visits from AI crawlers and from AI assistants, per page per day, shared with Zivooo only when you turn it on.
  • Clearer wording on the settings screen.

1.0.1

  • The connection panel no longer reports a key mismatch because of a stray request from somewhere else. Only a signature of the shape Zivooo sends is recorded, and it takes a second rejection to say the key is wrong.

1.0.0

  • First release.
